MemoryError("BindCraft 2 ran out of device memory in the Evoformer backward at 896 tokens.
  complex   870 residues, padded to 896 tokens (tt-bio buckets the token axis to 32)
  asked for 822.1 MB in one DRAM buffer (68.5 MB in each of 12 banks)
  free      4.386 GB of 12.885 GB, largest contiguous block 67.8 MB
This is fragmentation, not a full card: 4.386 GB is free, which would cover the 822.1 MB request if it were in one piece, but the largest contiguous block in a bank is 67.8 MB against the 68.5 MB that bank needs.
What to do: 896 tokens fits on a Wormhole Galaxy chip with the card to itself (the largest axis measured to complete a gradient round is 896), so something else is holding this card. Interleaved trajectories are the usual cause: pass trajectories_per_card=1 to run BindCraft 2's own one-at-a-time loop. Otherwise 6 residues off the binder takes this fold to 864 tokens.
The allocator's own refusal follows.")
